missing means the client is\n// still waiting at the end of the run.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) ClientOutcome(txn string) (string, bool) {\n\tv, ok := c.clientResult[txn]\n\treturn v, ok\n}\n\n// Crash simulates process death: the log survives, all memory is wiped.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) Crash() {\n\tif c.log != nil {\n\t\t_ = c.log.Close()\n\t\tc.log = nil\n\t}\n\tc.txns = nil\n\tc.clientResult = nil\n\tc.MarkDown()\n}\n\n// OnRestart rebuilds state from the WAL. Undecided transactions are aborted\n// (presumed-abort): because \"begin\" is durable before PREPARE is ever sent\n// and the decision is durable before COMMIT/ABORT is sent, a transaction\n// found undecided in the log was never decided anywhere, so abort is safe.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) OnRestart(now int64) {\n\tlg, err := wal.Open(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tc.log = lg\n\tc.txns = map[string]*txnState{}\n\tc.clientResult = map[string]string{}\n\trecs, err := wal.ReadAll(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tfor _, r := range recs {\n\t\tst, ok := c.txns[r.TxnID]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tmembers := c.members\n\t\t\tif len(r.Participants) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tmembers = toNodeIDs(r.Participants)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tst = &txnState{\n\t\t\t\tmembers: members,\n\t\t\t\twrites:  r.Writes,\n\t\t\t\tvotes:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\t\t\tacks:    map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tc.txns[r.TxnID] = st\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch r.Kind {\n\t\tcase \"begin\":\n\t\t\t// state already populated\n\t\tcase \"commit\":\n\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, true\n\t\tcase \"abort\":\n\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.MarkUp()\n\n\t// Recovery protocol.\n\tfor txn, st := range c.txns {\n\t\tif st.decided {\n\t\t\t// Decision is durable: re-drive it to every participant.\n\t\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-decision:\"+txn)\n\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n\t\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Undecided at restart: no decision message was ever sent, abort.\n\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: \"abort\", TxnID: txn}); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"abort\", txn)\n\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-abort-wal:\"+txn)\n\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc toNodeIDs(ss []string) []engine.NodeID {\n\tout := make([]engine.NodeID, len(ss))\n\tfor i, s := range ss {\n\t\tout[i] = engine.NodeID(s)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Begin starts one transaction (simulated client request).\nfunc (c *Coordinator) Begin(txn string, writes []wal.KVWrite) {\n\tst := &txnState{\n\t\twrites: writes,\n\t\tmembers: c.members,\n\t\tvotes:  map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\tacks:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t}\n\t// Participant list and writes are durable before any PREPARE leaves.\n\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{\n\t\tKind:         \"begin\",\n\t\tTxnID:        txn,\n\t\tParticipants: toStrings(c.members),\n\t\tWrites:       writes,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"begin\", txn)\n\tc.txns[txn] = st\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-begin-wal:\"+txn)\n\n\tfor _, p := range c.members {\n\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Prepare{TxnID: txn, Writes: writes})\n\t}\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-prepare-sent:\"+txn)\n\tc.startTicker(txn)\n}\n\nfunc toStrings(ns []engine.NodeID) []string {\n\tout := make([]string, len(ns))\n\tfor i, n := range ns {\n\t\tout[i] = string(n)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// startTicker drives retransmission for one transaction until it is done.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) startTicker(txn string) {\n\tvar tick func(now int64)\n\ttick = func(now int64) {\n\t\tst, ok := c.txns[txn]\n\t\tif !ok || st.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !st.decided {\n\t\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\t\tif _, has := st.votes[p]; !has {\n\t\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Prepare{TxnID: txn, Writes: st.writes})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n\t\t}\n\t\tengine.After(c.eng, &c.Base, RetryTicks, tick)\n\t}\n\tengine.After(c.eng, &c.Base, RetryTicks, tick)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) broadcastDecision(txn string, st *txnState) {\n\tif st.commit {\n\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Commit{TxnID: txn, Writes: st.writes})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Abort{TxnID: txn})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// HandleMessage dispatches one network message.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) HandleMessage(now int64, from engine.NodeID, payload any) {\n\tswitch m := payload.(type) {\n\tcase Vote:\n\t\tc.onVote(m, from)\n\tcase Ack:\n\t\tc.onAck(m, from)\n\tcase Query:\n\t\tc.onQuery(m, from)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onVote(m Vote, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif !ok || st.decided {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, seen := st.votes[from]; seen {\n\t\treturn // duplicate vote\n\t}\n\tst.votes[from] = m.Yes\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-vote-recv:\" + m.TxnID)\n\tif len(st.votes) == len(st.members) {\n\t\tallYes := true\n\t\tfor _, v := range st.votes {\n\t\t\tallYes = allYes && v\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Crash window after the vote set is complete, before the durable\n\t\t// decision is written.\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-votes-complete:\"+m.TxnID)\n\t\trec := \"abort\"\n\t\tif allYes {\n\t\t\trec = \"commit\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: rec, TxnID: m.TxnID}); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, allYes\n\t\t// Crash window after the decision is durable, before it is sent.\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-decision-wal:\"+m.TxnID)\n\t\tc.broadcastDecision(m.TxnID, st)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onAck(m Ack, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif !ok || !st.decided {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !st.acks[from] {\n\t\tst.acks[from] = true\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-ack-recv:\" + m.TxnID)\n\t}\n\tif len(st.acks) == len(st.members) && !st.done {\n\t\tst.done = true\n\t\toutcome := \"aborted\"\n\t\tif st.commit {\n\t\t\toutcome = \"committed\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-all-acked:\" + m.TxnID)\n\t\tc.clientResult[m.TxnID] = outcome\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onQuery(m Query, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n\treply := QueryReply{TxnID: m.TxnID}\n\tif ok && st.decided {\n\t\treply.Known = true\n\t\treply.Commit = st.commit\n\t\tif st.commit {\n\t\t\treply.Writes = st.writes\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), from, reply)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":246,"oldLines":6,"newStart":246,"newLines":7,"lines":["     if err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: rec, TxnID: m.TxnID}); err != nil {","       panic(err)","     }","+    durable(c.eng, c.ID(), rec, m.TxnID)","     st.decided, st.commit = true, allYes","     // Crash window after the decision is durable, before it is sent.","     c.CrashAt(\"c-decision-wal:\"+m.TxnID)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6e47e286-d81f-4b43-b393-48e84143deb0","session_id":"993d4cbe-fb6b-4271-a9ea-667a79c26473","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b","sessionId":"993d4cbe-fb6b-4271-a9ea-667a79c26473","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp27-b","slug":"structured-napping-fog"}

{"parentUuid":"8c5c89ae-b40b-4b30-a16e-fa02e72bad80","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_rkokqsyvte18pxen4q9kadcm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b/internal/harness/harness.go","content":"// Package harness wires a JSON scenario into the deterministic engine:\n// it creates the coordinator and three participants, installs crash rules\n// (by tick or by protocol milestone), runs the simulation and then judges\n// outcomes and safety invariants from the durable WAL files on disk.\npackage harness\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/engine\"\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/twopc\"\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/wal\"\n)\n\n// Request is one client transaction.\ntype Request struct {\n\tTxnID  string         `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tAt     int64          `json:\"at\"`\n\tWrites []wal.KVWrite  `json:\"writes\"`\n}\n\n// Crash describes one crash injection. Exactly one of At / Milestone must be\n// set: At crashes at a virtual tick; Milestone crashes when the named node\n// first reaches that protocol milestone.\ntype Crash struct {\n\tNode      string `json:\"node\"`\n\tAt        *int64 `json:\"at,omitempty\"`\n\tMilestone string `json:\"milestone,omitempty\"`\n\tDownTicks int64  `json:\"downTicks\"` // 0 = stays down for the whole run\n\tRepeat    int    `json:\"repeat\"`    // 0 = fires once; N = first N matches\n}\n\n// Spec is the JSON scenario document.\ntype Spec struct {\n\tSeed        int64                        `json:\"seed\"`\n\tHorizon     int64                        `json:\"horizon\"`\n\tNetwork     engine.NetConfig             `json:\"network\"`\n\tDataDir     string                       `json:\"dataDir,omitempty\"`\n\tRequests    []Request                    `json:\"requests\"`\n\tCrashes     []Crash                      `json:\"crashes\"`\n\tInitialKV   map[string]map[string]string `json:\"initialKv,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// BlockedInfo documents one transaction that is blocked at run end.\ntype BlockedInfo struct {\n\tTxnID         string   `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tPreparedNodes []string `json:\"preparedNodes\"`\n\tCoordinatorUp bool     `json:\"coordinatorUp\"`\n\tReason        string   `json:\"reason\"`\n\tQueryCount    int      `json:\"queryCount\"`\n}\n\n// TxnOutcome is the judged result for one client transaction.\ntype TxnOutcome struct {\n\tTxnID            string   `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tStatus           string   `json:\"status\"` // committed | aborted | blocked | ongoing\n\tCommittedNodes   []string `json:\"committedNodes,omitempty\"`\n\tAbortedNodes     []string `json:\"abortedNodes,omitempty\"`\n\tPreparedNodes    []string `json:\"preparedNodes,omitempty\"`\n\tCoordinatorUp    bool     `json:\"coordinatorUp\"`\n\tClientReported   string   `json:\"clientReported,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Result is the full run output.\ntype Result struct {\n\tSpec            Spec                   `json:\"spec\"`\n\tTrace           []engine.Record        `json:\"trace\"`\n\tTransactions    []TxnOutcome           `json:\"transactions\"`\n\tBlocked         []BlockedInfo          `json:\"blocked\"`\n\tFinalKV         map[string]map[string]string `json:\"finalKv\"`\n\tInvariantErrors []string               `json:\"invariantErrors\"`\n\tDataDir         string                 `json:\"dataDir\"`\n}\n\n// LoadSpec parses a scenario file.\nfunc LoadSpec(path string) (Spec, error) {\n\tvar s Spec\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn s, err\n\t}\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn s, err\n\t}\n\tif s.Horizon == 0 {\n\t\treturn s, fmt.Errorf(\"scenario %s: horizon is required\", path)\n\t}\n\treturn s, nil\n}\n\nconst coordID engine.NodeID = \"coord\"\n\nvar participantIDs = []engine.NodeID{\"p1\", \"p2\", \"p3\"}\n\n// Run executes a scenario and returns the judged result.\nfunc Run(s Spec) (Result, error) {\n\tdataDir := s.DataDir\n\tcleanup := false\n\tif dataDir == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tdataDir, err = os.MkdirTemp(\"\", \"twopc-\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{}, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tcleanup = true\n\t} else {\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(dataDir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{}, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tdefer func() {\n\t\tif cleanup {\n\t\t\t_ = os.RemoveAll(dataDir)\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n\n\tres := Result{Spec: s, DataDir: dataDir}\n\tvar trace []engine.Record\n\teng := engine.New(s.Seed, func(r engine.Record) { trace = append(trace, r) }, s.Network)\n\n\tcoord, err := twopc.NewCoordinator(eng, coordID, participantIDs, dataDir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn res, err\n\t}\n\tvar parts []*twopc.Participant\n\tfor _, pid := range participantIDs {\n\t\tp, err := twopc.NewParticipant(eng, pid, coordID, dataDir, s.InitialKV[string(pid)])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tparts = append(parts, p)\n\t}\n\teng.Register(coord)\n\tfor _, p := range parts {\n\t\teng.Register(p)\n\t}\n\n\t// --- crash rules ---------------------------------------------------\n\ttickCrash := map[int64][]Crash{}\n\tvar mileCrash []Crash\n\tremaining := map[int]int{} // index -> remaining matches\n\tfor i, c := range s.Crashes {\n\t\trepeat := c.Repeat\n\t\tif repeat == 0 {\n\t\t\trepeat = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tremaining[i] = repeat\n\t\tif c.Milestone != \"\" {\n\t\t\tmileCrash = append(mileCrash, c)\n\t\t} else if c.At != nil {\n\t\t\ttickCrash[*c.At] = append(tickCrash[*c.At], c)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\thook := engine.CrashHook(func(id engine.NodeID, milestone string) bool {\n\t\tcrashedSelf := false\n\t\tfor i, c := range mileCrash {\n\t\t\tif remaining[i] <= 0 {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif engine.NodeID(c.Node) != id || c.Milestone != milestone {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tremaining[i]--\n\t\t\teng.Crash(id, c.DownTicks)\n\t\t\tif engine.NodeID(c.Node) == id {\n\t\t\t\tcrashedSelf = true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn crashedSelf\n\t})\n\tcoord.Hook = hook\n\tfor _, p := range parts {\n\t\tp.Hook = hook\n\t}\n\n\t// tick-absolute crashes fire before any normal event at that tick\n\tfor at, cs := range tickCrash {\n\t\tcs := cs\n\t\tat := at\n\t\teng.ScheduleFunc(at, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tfor _, c := range cs {\n\t\t\t\teng.Crash(engine.NodeID(c.Node), c.DownTicks)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// --- client requests -----------------------------------------------\n\tfor _, req := range s.Requests {\n\t\treq := req\n\t\tat := req.At\n\t\teng.ScheduleFunc(at, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tcoord.Begin(req.TxnID, req.Writes)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\teng.Run(s.Horizon)\n\tres.Trace = trace\n\n\t// --- judgment from durable logs ------------------------------------\n\tjudge(&res, coord, parts)\n\n\t// close log handles\n\t_ = coord.Crash // no-op reference; explicit close below is not needed\n\tfor _, n := range append([]engine.Node{coord}, nodes(parts)...) {\n\t\tif cl, ok := n.(interface{ CloseLogs() }); received, client notified\n}\n\n// Coordinator implements the 2PC coordinator role.\ntype Coordinator struct {\n\tengine.Base\n\teng          *engine.Engine\n\tlogPath      string\n\tlog          *wal.Log\n\tmembers      []engine.NodeID\n\ttxns         map[string]*txnState\n\tclientResult map[string]string // txn -> \"committed\" | \"aborted\"\n}\n\n// NewCoordinator constructs the coordinator.\nfunc NewCoordinator(eng *engine.Engine, id engine.NodeID, members []engine.NodeID, dataDir string) (*Coordinator, error) {\n\tlg, err := wal.Open(dataDir, string(id))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tc := &Coordinator{\n\t\teng:          eng,\n\t\tlogPath:      dataDir,\n\t\tlog:          lg,\n\t\tmembers:      members,\n\t\ttxns:         map[string]*txnState{},\n\t\tclientResult: map[string]string{},\n\t}\n\tc.Base.NodeIDValue = id\n\treturn c, nil\n}\n\n// ClientOutcome returns the outcome reported to the client (\"committed\" /\n// \"aborted\") once all participants acknowledged; missing means the client is\n// still waiting at the end of the run.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) ClientOutcome(txn string) (string, bool) {\n\tv, ok := c.clientResult[txn]\n\treturn v, ok\n}\n\n// Crash simulates process death: the log survives, all memory is wiped.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) Crash() {\n\tif c.log != nil {\n\t\t_ = c.log.Close()\n\t\tc.log = nil\n\t}\n\tc.txns = nil\n\tc.clientResult = nil\n\tc.MarkDown()\n}\n\n// OnRestart rebuilds state from the WAL. Undecided transactions are aborted\n// (presumed-abort): because \"begin\" is durable before PREPARE is ever sent\n// and the decision is durable before COMMIT/ABORT is sent, a transaction\n// found undecided in the log was never decided anywhere, so abort is safe.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) OnRestart(now int64) {\n\tlg, err := wal.Open(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tc.log = lg\n\tc.txns = map[string]*txnState{}\n\tc.clientResult = map[string]string{}\n\trecs, err := wal.ReadAll(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tfor _, r := range recs {\n\t\tst, ok := c.txns[r.TxnID]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tmembers := c.members\n\t\t\tif len(r.Participants) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tmembers = toNodeIDs(r.Participants)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tst = &txnState{\n\t\t\t\tmembers: members,\n\t\t\t\twrites:  r.Writes,\n\t\t\t\tvotes:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\t\t\tacks:    map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tc.txns[r.TxnID] = st\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch r.Kind {\n\t\tcase \"begin\":\n\t\t\t// state already populated\n\t\tcase \"commit\":\n\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, true\n\t\tcase \"abort\":\n\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tc.MarkUp()\n\n\t// Recovery protocol.\n\tfor txn, st := range c.txns {\n\t\tif st.decided {\n\t\t\t// Decision is durable: re-drive it to every participant.\n\t\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-decision:\"+txn)\n\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n\t\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Undecided at restart: no decision message was ever sent, abort.\n\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: \"abort\", TxnID: txn}); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"abort\", txn)\n\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-abort-wal:\"+txn)\n\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc toNodeIDs(ss []string) []engine.NodeID {\n\tout := make([]engine.NodeID, len(ss))\n\tfor i, s := range ss {\n\t\tout[i] = engine.NodeID(s)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Begin starts one transaction (simulated client request).\nfunc (c *Coordinator) Begin(txn string, writes []wal.KVWrite) {\n\tst := &txnState{\n\t\twrites: writes,\n\t\tmembers: c.members,\n\t\tvotes:  map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t\tacks:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n\t}\n\t// Participant list and writes are durable before any PREPARE leaves.\n\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{\n\t\tKind:         \"begin\",\n\t\tTxnID:        txn,\n\t\tParticipants: toStrings(c.members),\n\t\tWrites:       writes,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"begin\", txn)\n\tc.txns[txn] = st\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-begin-wal:\"+txn)\n\n\tfor _, p := range c.members {\n\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Prepare{TxnID: txn, Writes: writes})\n\t}\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-prepare-sent:\"+txn)\n\tc.startTicker(txn)\n}\n\nfunc toStrings(ns []engine.NodeID) []string {\n\tout := make([]string, len(ns))\n\tfor i, n := range ns {\n\t\tout[i] = string(n)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// startTicker drives retransmission for one transaction until it is done.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) startTicker(txn string) {\n\tvar tick func(now int64)\n\ttick = func(now int64) {\n\t\tst, ok := c.txns[txn]\n\t\tif !ok || st.done {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !st.decided {\n\t\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\t\tif _, has := st.votes[p]; !has tick)\n\t}\n\tengine.After(c.eng, &c.Base, RetryTicks, tick)\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) broadcastDecision(txn string, st *txnState) {\n\tif st.commit {\n\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Commit{TxnID: txn, Writes: st.writes})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Abort{TxnID: txn})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// HandleMessage dispatches one network message.\nfunc (c *Coordinator) HandleMessage(now int64, from engine.NodeID, payload any) {\n\tswitch m := payload.(type) {\n\tcase Vote:\n\t\tc.onVote(m, from)\n\tcase Ack:\n\t\tc.onAck(m, from)\n\tcase Query:\n\t\tc.onQuery(m, from)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onVote(m Vote, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif !ok || st.decided {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, seen := st.votes[from]; seen {\n\t\treturn // duplicate vote\n\t}\n\tst.votes[from] = m.Yes\n\tc.CrashAt(\"c-vote-recv:\" + m.TxnID)\n\tif len(st.votes) == len(st.members) {\n\t\tallYes := true\n\t\tfor _, v := range st.votes {\n\t\t\tallYes = allYes && v\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Crash window after the vote set is complete, before the durable\n\t\t// decision is written.\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-votes-complete:\"+m.TxnID)\n\t\trec := \"abort\"\n\t\tif allYes {\n\t\t\trec = \"commit\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: rec, TxnID: m.TxnID}); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), rec, m.TxnID)\n\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, allYes\n\t\t// Crash window after the decision is durable, before it is sent.\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-decision-wal:\"+m.TxnID)\n\t\tc.broadcastDecision(m.TxnID, st)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onAck(m Ack, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif !ok || !st.decided {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !st.acks[from] {\n\t\tst.acks[from] = true\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-ack-recv:\" + m.TxnID)\n\t}\n\tif len(st.acks) == len(st.members) && !st.done {\n\t\tst.done = true\n\t\toutcome := \"aborted\"\n\t\tif st.commit {\n\t\t\toutcome = \"committed\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-all-acked:\" + m.TxnID)\n\t\tc.clientResult[m.TxnID] = outcome\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *Coordinator) onQuery(m Query, from engine.NodeID) {\n\tst, ok := {"parentUuid":"340b91ef-755f-49c4-99ab-afa6207abfb1","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_yyrlfh6rw7yaa6vx4uxow5e2","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b/internal/harness/harness_test.go","content":"package harness_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/engine\"\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/harness\"\n)\n\nfunc mustRun(t *testing.T, s harness.Spec) harness.Result {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := harness.Run(s)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"run: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc baseSpec() harness.Spec {\n\treturn harness.Spec{\n\t\tSeed:    42,\n\t\tHorizon: 400,\n\t\tNetwork: engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 1},\n\t\tRequests: []harness.Request{{\n\t\t\tTxnID:  \"T1\",\n\t\t\tAt:     10,\n\t\t\tWrites: []engineKV(\"balance\", \"100\"),\n\t\t}},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc engineKV(k, v string) []struct {\n\tKey   string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n} {\n\t// tiny helper converted through JSON to avoid importing wal.KVWrite here\n\traw := []map[string]string{{\"key\": k, \"value\": v}}\n\tb, _ := json.Marshal(raw)\n\tvar out []struct {\n\t\tKey   string `json:\"key\"`\n\t\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n\t}\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc milestoneCrash(node, m string, down int64) harness.Crash {\n\treturn harness.Crash{Node: node, Milestone: m, DownTicks: down}\n}\n\nfunc statusOf(res harness.Result, txn string) harness.TxnOutcome {\n\tfor _, x := range res.Transactions {\n\t\tif x.TxnID == txn {\n\t\t\treturn x\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn harness.TxnOutcome{}\n}\n\nfunc assertNoInvariantErrors(t *testing.T, res harness.Result) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tfor _, e := range res.InvariantErrors {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"invariant violation: %s\", e)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestHappyPath commits with no faults.\nfunc TestHappyPath(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRun(t, baseSpec())\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").ClientReported; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"client=%q want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestNetworkFaults commits despite loss, duplication and reordering.\nfunc TestNetworkFaults(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Horizon = 800\n\ts.Network = engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 4, Loss: 0.35, Duplicate: 0.25}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed under network faults\", got)\n\t}\n\t// The trace must actually exhibit the faults the test claims.\n\tvar drops, dups int\n\tfor _, r := range res.Trace {\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" {\n\t\t\tdrops++\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"dup\" {\n\t\t\tdups++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif drops == 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected dropped messages in trace, got 0\")\n\t}\n\tif dups == 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected duplicated messages in trace, got 0\")\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestVoteNo forces a NO vote; the global outcome must be abort.\nfunc TestVoteNo(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Requests[0].Writes = toWrites(\"balance\", \"@@NO\")\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"aborted\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want aborted\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared: nothing durable survives; commit.\nfunc TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-prepare-recv:T1\", 40)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared: prepared participant must NOT abort\n// unilaterally; it blocks/restarts, polls the coordinator, and commits.\nfunc TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-prepared-wal:T1\", 50)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed after prepared crash+restart\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestParticipantCrashAfterCommit: commit survives, duplicate COMMIT acked.\nfunc TestParticipantCrashAfterCommit(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-commit-wal:T1\", 50)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; harness.TxnOutcome{}\n}\n\nfunc assertNoInvariantErrors(t *testing.T, res harness.Result) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tfor _, e := range res.InvariantErrors {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"invariant violation: %s\", e)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestHappyPath commits with no faults.\nfunc TestHappyPath(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRun(t, baseSpec())\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").ClientReported; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"client=%q want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestNetworkFaults commits despite loss, duplication and reordering.\nfunc TestNetworkFaults(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Horizon = 800\n\ts.Network = engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 4, Loss: 0.35, Duplicate: 0.25}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed under network faults\", got)\n\t}\n\t// The trace must actually exhibit the faults the test claims.\n\tvar drops, dups int\n\tfor _, r := range res.Trace {\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" {\n\t\t\tdrops++\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"dup\" {\n\t\t\tdups++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif drops == 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected dropped messages in trace, got 0\")\n\t}\n\tif dups == 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected duplicated messages in trace, got 0\")\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestVoteNo forces a NO vote; the global outcome must be abort.\nfunc TestVoteNo(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Requests[0].Writes = toWrites(\"balance\", \"@@NO\")\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"aborted\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want aborted\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared: nothing durable survives; commit.\nfunc TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-prepare-recv:T1\", 40)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared: prepared participant must NOT abort\n// unilaterally; it blocks/restarts, polls the coordinator, and commits.\nfunc TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-commit-wal:T1\", 50)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestCoordCrashBeforeDecision: restart finds an undecided txn and aborts it.\nfunc TestCoordCrashBeforeDecision(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-votes-complete:T1\", 40)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"aborted\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want aborted (presumed-abort at recovery)\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestCoordCrashAfterDecision: durable COMMIT re-driven after restart.\nfunc TestCoordCrashAfterDecision(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-decision-wal:T1\", 40)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed from recovered decision\", got)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n}\n\n// TestBlockingCoordDown is the explicit blocking evidence: coordinator\n// crashes after durable COMMIT and never returns. Participants stay\n// PREPARED, keep polling, and must not abort.\nfunc TestBlockingCoordDown(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := baseSpec()\n\ts.Horizon = 300\n\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-decision-wal:T1\", 0)}\n\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\n\tout := statusOf(res, \"T1\")\n\tif out.Status != \"blocked\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%q want blocked\", out.Status)\n\t}\n\tif out.CoordinatorUp {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"coordinator should still be down\")\n\t}\n\tif len(out.PreparedNodes) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"prepared nodes=%v want all 3 blocked\", out.PreparedNodes)\n\t}\n\tif len(out.CommittedNodes) != 0 || len(out.AbortedNodes) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"no node may commit or abort: commit=%v abort=%v\",\n\t\t\tout.CommittedNodes, out.AbortedNodes)\n\t}\n\tif len(res.Blocked) != 1 || res.Blocked[0].QueryCount == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected one blocked txn with repeated QUERY evidence, got %+v\", res.Blocked)\n\t}\n\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res) // blocking, but never inconsistent\n}\n\n// TestBlockingParticipantDown: one participant never returns after voting\n// YES; i < 20; i++ {\n\t\t\ti := i\n\t\t\teng.ScheduleFunc(0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\t\teng.Send(a.ID(), b.ID(), string(rune('A'+i%4)))\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\teng.Run(100)\n\t\tif len(b.got) == 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected some deliveries\")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn trace\n\t}\n\tt1 := run()\n\tt2 := run()\n\tif len(t1) != len(t2) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace length differs: %d vs %d\", len(t1), len(t2))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range t1 {\n\t\tif t1[i] != t2[i] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace differs at %d:\\n%+v\\n%+v\", i, t1[i], t2[i])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Messages to a crashed node are dropped; stale pre-crash timers never fire.\nfunc TestCrashDropsMessagesAndTimers(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar trace []Record\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) { trace = append(trace, r) },\n\t\tNetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\n\t// Timer armed on b before the crash; it must not fire after crash.\n\tfired := false\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) {\n\t\tAfter(eng, &b.Base, 5, func(now int64) { fired = true })\n\t})\n\t// b crashes at tick 3 and stays down.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(3, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 0) })\n\t// a sends at tick 4 (delivered tick 5) — must be dropped.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(4, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"x\") })\n\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif fired {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stale timer fired across crash\")\n\t}\n\tif len(b.got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"crashed node received messages: %+v\", b.got)\n\t}\n\tfoundDrop := false\n\tfor _, r := range trace {\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" && r.Detail == \"to=b type=string reason=node-down\" {\n\t\t\tfoundDrop = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !foundDrop {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected node-down drop record in trace\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// After restart, the node delivers again.\nfunc TestRestartDelivers(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) {}, NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 10) })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(5, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"while-down\") })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(20, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"after-up\") })\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif len(b.got) != 1 || b.got[0].what != \"after-up\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %+v, want only after-up\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Milestone crash hook: sentinel aborts the handler; code after CrashAt in\n// the handler must not execute.\nfunc TestMilestoneHookAbortsHandler(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) {}, NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\tn := &hookNode{}\n\tn.Base.NodeIDValue = \"h\"\n\tn.eng = eng\n\teng.Register(n)\n\n\tn.Hook = func(id NodeID, milestone string) bool {\n\t\tif milestone == \"boom\" {\n\t\t\teng.Crash(id, 0)\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.run()\n\tif n.afterCrashRan {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"code after crashing milestone executed\")\n\t}\n}\n\ntype hookNode struct {\n\tBase\n\teng           *Engine\n\tafterCrashRan bool\n}\n\nfunc (n *hookNode) HandleMessage(now int64, from NodeID, payload any) {}\nfunc (n *hookNode) OnRestart(now int64)                                {}\nfunc (n *hookNode) Crash()                                             { n.MarkDown() }\nfunc (n *hookNode) run() {\n\tdefer func() {\n\t\tif r := recover(); i < 20; i++ {\n\t\t\ti := i\n\t\t\teng.ScheduleFunc(0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\t\teng.Send(a.ID(), b.ID(), string(rune('A'+i%4)))\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\teng.Run(100)\n\t\tif len(b.got) == 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected some deliveries\")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn trace\n\t}\n\tt1 := run()\n\tt2 := run()\n\tif len(t1) != len(t2) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace length differs: %d vs %d\", len(t1), len(t2))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range t1 {\n\t\tif t1[i] != t2[i] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace differs at %d:\\n%+v\\n%+v\", i, t1[i], t2[i])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Messages to a crashed node are dropped; stale pre-crash timers never fire.\nfunc TestCrashDropsMessagesAndTimers(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar trace []Record\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) { trace = append(trace, r) },\n\t\tNetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\n\t// Timer armed on b before the crash; it must not fire after crash.\n\tfired := false\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) {\n\t\tAfter(eng, &b.Base, 5, func(now int64) { fired = true })\n\t})\n\t// b crashes at tick 3 and stays down.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(3, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 0) })\n\t// a sends at tick 4 (delivered tick 5) — must be dropped.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(4, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"x\") })\n\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif fired {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stale timer fired across crash\")\n\t}\n\tif len(b.got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"crashed node received messages: %+v\", b.got)\n\t}\n\tfoundDrop := false\n\tfor _, r := range trace {\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" && r.Detail == \"to=b type=string reason=node-down\" {\n\t\t\tfoundDrop = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !foundDrop {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected node-down drop record in trace\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// After restart, the node delivers again.\nfunc TestRestartDelivers(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) {}, NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 10) })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(5, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"while-down\") })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(20, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"after-up\") })\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif len(b.got) != 1 || b.got[0].what != \"after-up\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %+v, want only after-up\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Milestone crash hook: sentinel aborts the handler; i < 20; i++ {\n\t\t\ti := i\n\t\t\teng.ScheduleFunc(0, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\t\teng.Send(a.ID(), b.ID(), string(rune('A'+i%4)))\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t\teng.Run(100)\n\t\tif len(b.got) == 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected some deliveries\")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn trace\n\t}\n\tt1 := run()\n\tt2 := run()\n\tif len(t1) != len(t2) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace length differs: %d vs %d\", len(t1), len(t2))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range t1 {\n\t\tif t1[i] != t2[i] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace differs at %d:\\n%+v\\n%+v\", i, t1[i], t2[i])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Messages to a crashed node are dropped; stale pre-crash timers never fire.\nfunc TestCrashDropsMessagesAndTimers(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar trace []Record\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) { trace = append(trace, r) },\n\t\tNetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\n\t// Timer armed on b before the crash; it must not fire after crash.\n\tfired := false\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) {\n\t\tAfter(eng, &b.Base, 5, func(now int64) { fired = true })\n\t})\n\t// b crashes at tick 3 and stays down.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(3, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 0) })\n\t// a sends at tick 4 (delivered tick 5) — must be dropped.\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(4, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"x\") })\n\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif fired {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"stale timer fired across crash\")\n\t}\n\tif len(b.got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"crashed node received messages: %+v\", b.got)\n\t}\n\tfoundDrop := false\n\tfor _, r := range trace {\n\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" && r.Detail == \"to=b type=string reason=node-down\" {\n\t\t\tfoundDrop = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !foundDrop {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected node-down drop record in trace\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// After restart, the node delivers again.\nfunc TestRestartDelivers(t *testing.T) {\n\teng := New(1, func(r Record) {}, NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})\n\ta := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")\n\tb := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(1, func(now int64) { eng.Crash(\"b\", 10) })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(5, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"while-down\") })\n\teng.ScheduleFunc(20, func(now int64) { eng.Send(\"a\", \"b\", \"after-up\") })\n\teng.Run(50)\n\tif len(b.got) != 1 || b.got[0].what != \"after-up\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %+v, want only after-up\", b.got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Milestone crash hook: sentinel aborts the handler; r != nil {\n\t\t\t\tpanicked = true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}()\n\t\tn.CrashAt(\"boom\")\n\t}()\n\tif !panicked {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"CrashAt did not unwind the crashing handler\")\n\t}\n\tif n.afterCrashRan {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"code after crashing milestone executed\")\n\t}\n}\n\ntype hookNode struct {\n\tBase\n\teng           *Engine\n\tafterCrashRan bool\n}\n\nfunc (n *hookNode) HandleMessage(now int64, from NodeID, payload any) {}\nfunc (n *hookNode) OnRestart(now int64)                                {}\nfunc (n *hookNode) Crash()                                             { n.MarkDown() }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":71,"oldLines":6,"newStart":71,"newLines":7,"lines":["     NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 0})","   a := newTestNode(eng, \"a\")","   b := newTestNode(eng, \"b\")","+  _ = a"," ","   // Timer armed on b before the crash; {"parentUuid":"768f5ff0-891c-47ec-a46f-fbc9c3505d49","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_7bookn4ymbeka9z4qo69bk0x","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b/internal/harness/crash_stages_test.go","content":"package harness_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"twopc-sim/internal/harness\"\n)\n\n// TestCrashAtEveryProtocolStage injects a crash at every named protocol\n// milestone. For every stage the run must end in exactly one of:\n// committed, aborted or blocked — never partial-commit — and the safety\n// invariants must always hold.\nfunc TestCrashAtEveryProtocolStage(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := []struct {\n\t\tnode, milestone string\n\t\tdown            int64\n\t}{\n\t\t// coordinator stages\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-begin-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-prepare-sent:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-vote-recv:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-votes-complete:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-decision-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-ack-recv:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"coord\", \"c-all-acked:T1\", 40},\n\t\t// participant stages\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-prepare-recv:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-prepared-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-vote-sent:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-commit-recv:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-commit-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p1\", \"p-abort-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p2\", \"p-prepared-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t\t{\"p3\", \"p-commit-wal:T1\", 40},\n\t}\n\tallowed := map[string]bool{\"committed\": true, \"aborted\": true, \"blocked\": true}\n\tfor _, tc := range cases {\n\t\ttc := tc\n\t\tname := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%s\", tc.node, tc.milestone)\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\ts := baseSpec()\n\t\t\ts.Horizon = 600\n\t\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{{Node: tc.node, Milestone: tc.milestone, DownTicks: tc.down}}\n\t\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n\t\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n\t\t\tout := statusOf(res, \"T1\")\n\t\t\tif !allowed[out.Status] {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%q (committed=%v aborted=%v prepared=%v)\",\n\t\t\t\t\tout.Status, out.CommittedNodes, out.AbortedNodes, out.PreparedNodes)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// A crash during abort handling: p1 must vote NO path to reach\n\t\t\t// p-abort-wal, otherwise the milestone never fires; {"parentUuid":"185bf05e-bfef-48ab-aed6-4fa4ae78f5c5","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b/internal/harness/harness_test.go","snippet":"1\tpackage harness_test\n2\t\n3\timport (\n4\t\t\"encoding/json\"\n5\t\t\"os\"\n6\t\t\"path/filepath\"\n7\t\t\"testing\"\n8\t\n9\t\t\"twopc-sim/internal/engine\"\n10\t\t\"twopc-sim/internal/harness\"\n11\t\t\"twopc-sim/internal/wal\"\n12\t)\n13\t\n14\tfunc toWrites(k, v string) []wal.KVWrite { return []wal.KVWrite{{Key: k, Value: v}} }\n15\t\n16\tfunc mustRun(t *testing.T, s harness.Spec) harness.Result {\n17\t\tt.Helper()\n18\t\tres, err := harness.Run(s)\n19\t\tif err != nil {\n20\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"run: %v\", err)\n21\t\t}\n22\t\treturn res\n23\t}\n24\t\n25\tfunc baseSpec() harness.Spec {\n26\t\treturn harness.Spec{\n27\t\t\tSeed:    42,\n28\t\t\tHorizon: 400,\n29\t\t\tNetwork: engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 1},\n30\t\t\tRequests: []harness.Request{{\n31\t\t\t\tTxnID:  \"T1\",\n32\t\t\t\tAt:     10,\n33\t\t\t\tWrites: toWrites(\"balance\", \"100\"),\n34\t\t\t}},\n35\t\t}\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\tfunc milestoneCrash(node, m string, down int64) harness.Crash {\n39\t\treturn harness.Crash{Node: node, Milestone: m, DownTicks: down}\n40\t}\n41\t\n42\tfunc statusOf(res harness.Result, txn string) harness.TxnOutcome {\n43\t\tfor _, x := range res.Transactions {\n44\t\t\tif x.TxnID == txn {\n45\t\t\t\treturn x\n46\t\t\t}\n47\t\t}\n48\t\treturn harness.TxnOutcome{}\n49\t}\n50\t\n51\tfunc assertNoInvariantErrors(t *testing.T, res harness.Result) {\n52\t\tt.Helper()\n53\t\tfor _, e := range res.InvariantErrors {\n54\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"invariant violation: %s\", e)\n55\t\t}\n56\t}\n57\t\n58\t// TestHappyPath commits with no faults.\n59\tfunc TestHappyPath(t *testing.T) {\n60\t\tres := mustRun(t, baseSpec())\n61\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n62\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n63\t\t}\n64\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").ClientReported; got != \"committed\" {\n65\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"client=%q want committed\", got)\n66\t\t}\n67\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n68\t}\n69\t\n70\t// TestNetworkFaults commits despite loss, duplication and reordering.\n71\tfunc TestNetworkFaults(t *testing.T) {\n72\t\ts := baseSpec()\n73\t\ts.Horizon = 800\n74\t\ts.Network = engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 4, Loss: 0.35, Duplicate: 0.25}\n75\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n76\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n77\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed under network faults\", got)\n78\t\t}\n79\t\t// The trace must actually exhibit the faults the test claims.\n80\t\tvar drops, dups int\n81\t\tfor _, r := range res.Trace {\n82\t\t\tif r.Kind == \"drop\" {\n83\t\t\t\tdrops++\n84\t\t\t}\n85\t\t\tif r.Kind == \"dup\" {\n86\t\t\t\tdups++\n87\t\t\t}\n88\t\t}\n89\t\tif drops == 0 {\n90\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected dropped messages in trace, got 0\")\n91\t\t}\n92\t\tif dups == 0 {\n93\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"expected duplicated messages in trace, got 0\")\n94\t\t}\n95\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n96\t}\n97\t\n98\t// TestVoteNo forces a NO vote; the global outcome must be abort.\n99\tfunc TestVoteNo(t *testing.T) {\n100\t\ts := baseSpec()\n101\t\ts.Requests[0].Writes = toWrites(\"balance\", \"@@NO\")\n102\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n103\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"aborted\" {\n104\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want aborted\", got)\n105\t\t}\n106\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n107\t}\n108\t\n109\t// TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared: nothing durable survives; commit.\n110\tfunc TestParticipantCrashBeforePrepared(t *testing.T) {\n111\t\ts := baseSpec()\n112\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-prepare-recv:T1\", 40)}\n113\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n114\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n115\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n116\t\t}\n117\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n118\t}\n119\t\n120\t// TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared: prepared participant must NOT abort\n121\t// unilaterally; it blocks/restarts, polls the coordinator, and commits.\n122\tfunc TestParticipantCrashAfterPrepared(t *testing.T) {\n123\t\ts := baseSpec()\n124\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-prepared-wal:T1\", 50)}\n125\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n126\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n127\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed after prepared crash+restart\", got)\n128\t\t}\n129\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n130\t}\n131\t\n132\t// TestParticipantCrashAfterCommit: commit survives, duplicate COMMIT acked.\n133\tfunc TestParticipantCrashAfterCommit(t *testing.T) {\n134\t\ts := baseSpec()\n135\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-commit-wal:T1\", 50)}\n136\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n137\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n138\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed\", got)\n139\t\t}\n140\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n141\t}\n142\t\n143\t// TestCoordCrashBeforeDecision: restart finds an undecided txn and aborts it.\n144\tfunc TestCoordCrashBeforeDecision(t *testing.T) {\n145\t\ts := baseSpec()\n146\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-votes-complete:T1\", 40)}\n147\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n148\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"aborted\" {\n149\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want aborted (presumed-abort at recovery)\", got)\n150\t\t}\n151\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n152\t}\n153\t\n154\t// TestCoordCrashAfterDecision: durable COMMIT re-driven after restart.\n155\tfunc TestCoordCrashAfterDecision(t *testing.T) {\n156\t\ts := baseSpec()\n157\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-decision-wal:T1\", 40)}\n158\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n159\t\tif got := statusOf(res, \"T1\").Status; got != \"committed\" {\n160\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%s want committed from recovered decision\", got)\n161\t\t}\n162\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// TestBlockingCoordDown is the explicit blocking evidence: coordinator\n166\t// crashes after durable COMMIT and never returns. Participants stay\n167\t// PREPARED, keep polling, and must not abort.\n168\tfunc TestBlockingCoordDown(t *testing.T) {\n169\t\ts := baseSpec()\n170\t\ts.Horizon = 300\n171\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"coord\", \"c-decision-wal:T1\", 0)}\n172\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n173\t\n174\t\tout := statusOf(res, \"T1\")\n175\t\tif out.Status != \"blocked\" {\n176\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%q want blocked\", out.Status)\n177\t\t}\n178\t\tif out.CoordinatorUp {\n179\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"coordinator should still be down\")\n180\t\t}\n181\t\tif len(out.PreparedNodes) != 3 {\n182\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"prepared nodes=%v want all 3 blocked\", out.PreparedNodes)\n183\t\t}\n184\t\tif len(out.CommittedNodes) != 0 || len(out.AbortedNodes) != 0 {\n185\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"no node may commit or abort: commit=%v abort=%v\",\n186\t\t\t\tout.CommittedNodes, out.AbortedNodes)\n187\t\t}\n188\t\tif len(res.Blocked) != 1 || res.Blocked[0].QueryCount == 0 {\n189\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected one blocked txn with repeated QUERY evidence, got %+v\", res.Blocked)\n190\t\t}\n191\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res) // blocking, but never inconsistent\n192\t}\n193\t\n194\t// TestBlockingParticipantDown: one participant never returns after voting\n195\t// YES; others commit, it stays PREPARED — blocked termination, still atomic.\n196\tfunc TestBlockingParticipantDown(t *testing.T) {\n197\t\ts := baseSpec()\n198\t\ts.Horizon = 300\n199\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p1\", \"p-vote-sent:T1\", 0)}\n200\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n201\t\n202\t\tout := statusOf(res, \"T1\")\n203\t\tif out.Status != \"blocked\" {\n204\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"status=%q want blocked\", out.Status)\n205\t\t}\n206\t\tif !contains(out.CommittedNodes, \"p2\") || !contains(out.CommittedNodes, \"p3\") {\n207\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"p2/p3 should have durable-committed: %v\", out.CommittedNodes)\n208\t\t}\n209\t\tif !contains(out.PreparedNodes, \"p1\") {\n210\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"p1 should remain prepared, got prepared=%v\", out.PreparedNodes)\n211\t\t}\n212\t\tif len(out.AbortedNodes) != 0 {\n213\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"no node may abort a committing transaction: %v\", out.AbortedNodes)\n214\t\t}\n215\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n216\t}\n217\t\n218\t// TestDeterminism: same seed twice => byte-identical traces; across seeds\n219\t// the safety invariants still hold.\n220\tfunc TestDeterminism(t *testing.T) {\n221\t\ts := baseSpec()\n222\t\ts.Network = engine.NetConfig{BaseDelay: 1, Jitter: 4, Loss: 0.3, Duplicate: 0.2}\n223\t\ts.Horizon = 500\n224\t\ts.Crashes = []harness.Crash{milestoneCrash(\"p2\", \"p-prepared-wal:T1\", 60)}\n225\t\n226\t\tr1 := mustRun(t, s)\n227\t\tr2 := mustRun(t, s)\n228\t\tb1, _ := json.Marshal(r1.Trace)\n229\t\tb2, _ := json.Marshal(r2.Trace)\n230\t\tif string(b1) != string(b2) {\n231\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"non-deterministic traces for identical seed\")\n232\t\t}\n233\t\n234\t\tfor seed := int64(1); seed <= 8; seed++ {\n235\t\t\ts.Seed = seed\n236\t\t\tres := mustRun(t, s)\n237\t\t\tassertNoInvariantErrors(t, res)\n238\t\t}\n239\t}\n240\t\n\n... Undecided transactions are aborted\n68\t// (presumed-abort): because \"begin\" is durable before PREPARE is ever sent\n69\t// and the decision is durable before COMMIT/ABORT is sent, a transaction\n70\t// found undecided in the log was never decided anywhere, so abort is safe.\n71\tfunc (c *Coordinator) OnRestart(now int64) {\n72\t\tlg, err := wal.Open(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n73\t\tif err != nil {\n74\t\t\tpanic(err)\n75\t\t}\n76\t\tc.log = lg\n77\t\tc.txns = map[string]*txnState{}\n78\t\tc.clientResult = map[string]string{}\n79\t\trecs, err := wal.ReadAll(c.logPath, string(c.ID()))\n80\t\tif err != nil {\n81\t\t\tpanic(err)\n82\t\t}\n83\t\tfor _, r := range recs {\n84\t\t\tst, ok := c.txns[r.TxnID]\n85\t\t\tif !ok {\n86\t\t\t\tmembers := c.members\n87\t\t\t\tif len(r.Participants) > 0 {\n88\t\t\t\t\tmembers = toNodeIDs(r.Participants)\n89\t\t\t\t}\n90\t\t\t\tst = &txnState{\n91\t\t\t\t\tmembers: members,\n92\t\t\t\t\twrites:  r.Writes,\n93\t\t\t\t\tvotes:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n94\t\t\t\t\tacks:    map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n95\t\t\t\t}\n96\t\t\t\tc.txns[r.TxnID] = st\n97\t\t\t}\n98\t\t\tswitch r.Kind {\n99\t\t\tcase \"begin\":\n100\t\t\t\t// state already populated\n101\t\t\tcase \"commit\":\n102\t\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, true\n103\t\t\tcase \"abort\":\n104\t\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n105\t\t\t}\n106\t\t}\n107\t\tc.MarkUp()\n108\t\n109\t\t// Recovery protocol.\n110\t\tfor txn, st := range c.txns {\n111\t\t\tif st.decided {\n112\t\t\t\t// Decision is durable: re-drive it to every participant.\n113\t\t\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-decision:\" + txn)\n114\t\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n115\t\t\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n116\t\t\t\tcontinue\n117\t\t\t}\n118\t\t\t// Undecided at restart: no decision message was ever sent, abort.\n119\t\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: \"abort\", TxnID: txn}); err != nil {\n120\t\t\t\tpanic(err)\n121\t\t\t}\n122\t\t\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"abort\", txn)\n123\t\t\tst.decided, st.commit = true, false\n124\t\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-recovery-abort-wal:\" + txn)\n125\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n126\t\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n127\t\t}\n128\t}\n129\t\n130\tfunc toNodeIDs(ss []string) []engine.NodeID {\n131\t\tout := make([]engine.NodeID, len(ss))\n132\t\tfor i, s := range ss {\n133\t\t\tout[i] = engine.NodeID(s)\n134\t\t}\n135\t\treturn out\n136\t}\n137\t\n138\t// Begin starts one transaction (simulated client request).\n139\tfunc (c *Coordinator) Begin(txn string, writes []wal.KVWrite) {\n140\t\tst := &txnState{\n141\t\t\twrites:  writes,\n142\t\t\tmembers: c.members,\n143\t\t\tvotes:   map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n144\t\t\tacks:    map[engine.NodeID]bool{},\n145\t\t}\n146\t\t// Participant list and writes are durable before any PREPARE leaves.\n147\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{\n148\t\t\tKind:         \"begin\",\n149\t\t\tTxnID:        txn,\n150\t\t\tParticipants: toStrings(c.members),\n151\t\t\tWrites:       writes,\n152\t\t}); err != nil {\n153\t\t\tpanic(err)\n154\t\t}\n155\t\tdurable(c.eng, c.ID(), \"begin\", txn)\n156\t\tc.txns[txn] = st\n157\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-begin-wal:\" + txn)\n158\t\n159\t\tfor _, p := range c.members {\n160\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Prepare{TxnID: txn, Writes: writes})\n161\t\t}\n162\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-prepare-sent:\" + txn)\n163\t\tc.startTicker(txn)\n164\t}\n165\t\n166\tfunc toStrings(ns []engine.NodeID) []string {\n167\t\tout := make([]string, len(ns))\n168\t\tfor i, n := range ns {\n169\t\t\tout[i] = string(n)\n170\t\t}\n171\t\treturn out\n172\t}\n173\t\n174\t// startTicker drives retransmission for one transaction until it is done.\n175\tfunc (c *Coordinator) startTicker(txn string) {\n176\t\tvar tick func(now int64)\n177\t\ttick = func(now int64) {\n178\t\t\tst, ok := c.txns[txn]\n179\t\t\tif !ok || st.done {\n180\t\t\t\treturn\n181\t\t\t}\n182\t\t\tif !st.decided {\n183\t\t\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n184\t\t\t\t\tif _, has := st.votes[p]; !has {\n185\t\t\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Prepare{TxnID: txn, Writes: st.writes})\n186\t\t\t\t\t}\n187\t\t\t\t}\n188\t\t\t} else {\n189\t\t\t\tc.broadcastDecision(txn, st)\n190\t\t\t}\n191\t\t\tengine.After(c.eng, &c.Base, RetryTicks, tick)\n192\t\t}\n193\t\tengine.After(c.eng, &c.Base, RetryTicks, tick)\n194\t}\n195\t\n196\tfunc (c *Coordinator) broadcastDecision(txn string, st *txnState) {\n197\t\tif st.commit {\n198\t\t\tc.eng.Trace(\"decision-send\", string(c.ID()), \"txn=\"+txn+\" decision=commit\")\n199\t\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n200\t\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n201\t\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Commit{TxnID: txn, Writes: st.writes})\n202\t\t\t\t}\n203\t\t\t}\n204\t\t} else {\n205\t\t\tc.eng.Trace(\"decision-send\", string(c.ID()), \"txn=\"+txn+\" decision=abort\")\n206\t\t\tfor _, p := range st.members {\n207\t\t\t\tif !st.acks[p] {\n208\t\t\t\t\tc.eng.Send(c.ID(), p, Abort{TxnID: txn})\n209\t\t\t\t}\n210\t\t\t}\n211\t\t}\n212\t}\n213\t\n214\t// HandleMessage dispatches one network message.\n215\tfunc (c *Coordinator) HandleMessage(now int64, from engine.NodeID, payload any) {\n216\t\tswitch m := payload.(type) {\n217\t\tcase Vote:\n218\t\t\tc.onVote(m, from)\n219\t\tcase Ack:\n220\t\t\tc.onAck(m, from)\n221\t\tcase Query:\n222\t\t\tc.onQuery(m, from)\n223\t\t}\n224\t}\n225\t\n226\tfunc (c *Coordinator) onVote(m Vote, from engine.NodeID) {\n227\t\tst, ok := c.txns[m.TxnID]\n228\t\tif !ok || st.decided {\n229\t\t\treturn\n230\t\t}\n231\t\tif _, seen := st.votes[from]; seen {\n232\t\t\treturn // duplicate vote\n233\t\t}\n234\t\tst.votes[from] = m.Yes\n235\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-vote-recv:\" + m.TxnID)\n236\t\tif len(st.votes) == len(st.members) {\n237\t\t\tallYes := true\n238\t\t\tfor _, v := range st.votes {\n239\t\t\t\tallYes = allYes && v\n240\t\t\t}\n241\t\t\t// Crash window after the vote set is complete, before the durable\n242\t\t\t// decision is written.\n243\t\t\tc.CrashAt(\"c-votes-complete:\" + m.TxnID)\n244\t\t\trec := \"abort\"\n245\t\t\tif allYes {\n246\t\t\t\trec = \"commit\"\n247\t\t\t}\n248\t\t\tif err := c.log.Append(wal.Record{Kind: rec, TxnID: m.TxnID}); {"parentUuid":"3ddf8ca0-a2f6-4946-95f8-76f965c6a773","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_t7xidn6r33n9ve9us63g7s1n","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/b/README.md","content":"# 两阶段提交（2PC）崩溃恢复 —— 确定性离散事件模拟器\n\n纯后端项目。在**单进程内**模拟 1 个协调者（coordinator）+ 3 个参与者（participant，p1/p2/p3），\n使用确定性离散事件仿真（virtual clock + 事件队列），网络可配置**丢包、重复、乱序**，\n支持在任意协议里程碑精确注入崩溃与重启。**不依赖任何真实集群、网络、goroutine 或系统时钟**；\n相同输入（含随机种子）必然产生逐字节一致的执行轨迹。\n\n本项目如实建模**阻塞式 2PC**：参与者一旦把 `prepared` 持久化，就**不允许自行超时回滚**；\n当协调者不可用时，相关事务会**阻塞**——这是 2PC 的本质属性，本项目用专门的场景和量化证据\n展示阻塞，而不是伪装成\"始终可用\"。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 目录结构\n\n```\n.\n├── go.mod\n├── main.go                     # CLI：读取 JSON 场景 -> 运行 -> 输出 JSON 结果 + 摘要\n├── internal/\n│   ├── engine/                 # 离散事件内核：虚拟时钟、事件堆、不可靠网络、崩溃/重启\n│   ├── wal/                    # 预写日志：每条记录 Append 后 fsync，崩溃后重放恢复\n│   ├── twopc/                  # 协调者 / 参与者状态机 + 协议消息\n│   └── harness/                # JSON 场景装配、崩溃注入、结果判定与安全不变量检查\n├── scenarios/                  # 10 个 JSON 请求样例（也是验收用例）\n└── examples/output/            # 部分场景的真实运行输出（完整事件轨迹证据）\n```\n\n## 2. 构建与运行\n\n要求 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo run . scenarios/01-happy-commit.json            # 完整 JSON 打到 stdout，摘要打到 stderr\ngo run . --quiet scenarios/08-blocking-coord-down.json   # 只看摘要\ngo run . --out result.json scenarios/07-coord-crash-after-decision.json\ngo test ./... -count=1\n```\n\n## 3. JSON 请求格式（场景文件）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"seed\": 1,\n  \"horizon\": 120,\n  \"network\": { \"baseDelay\": 1, \"jitter\": 1, \"loss\": 0.0, \"duplicate\": 0.0 },\n  \"dataDir\": \"\",\n  \"requests\": [\n    { \"txnId\": \"T1\", \"at\": 10, \"writes\": [ { \"key\": \"balance\", \"value\": \"100\" } ] }\n  ],\n  \"crashes\": [\n    { \"node\": \"coord\", \"milestone\": \"c-decision-wal:T1\", \"downTicks\": 40 }\n  ],\n  \"initialKv\": { \"p1\": { \"x\": \"1\" } }\n}\n```\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子，决定丢包/重复/延迟抖动；同种子结果确定 |\n| `horizon` | 虚拟时钟上界（ticks），事件队列排干或超过该值即停 |\n| `network.baseDelay` / `jitter` | 单向延迟 = baseDelay + uniform[0,jitter]，抖动天然造成**乱序** |\n| `network.loss` / `duplicate` | 每条消息独立的丢包 / 重复投递概率 |\n| `requests[].at` | 客户端 `BEGIN` 到达时刻；`writes` 为该事务的 KV 写集（发给全部 3 个参与者） |\n| `crashes[].node` | `coord` / `p1` / `p2` / `p3` |\n| `crashes[].milestone` | 在指定协议里程碑崩溃（见下表），崩溃点**精确到 fsync 边界** |\n| `crashes[].at` | 或按绝对 tick 崩溃（与 milestone 二选一） |\n| `crashes[].downTicks` | 崩溃多久后重启；**0 表示整个运行期间永不恢复**（用于阻塞演示） |\n| `dataDir` | WAL 落盘目录；留空则用临时目录，运行结束删除 |\n\n投票策略：写集里出现 value 为 `@@NO`（或 key 以 `!` 开头）的写时，参与者投 NO，用于强制全局中止路径。\n\n### 可注入崩溃的协议里程碑\n\n| 里程碑 | 语义（崩溃发生在……之后、……之前） |\n|---|---|\n| `c-begin-wal:<txn>` | 协调者 `begin` 记录 fsync 之后、PREPARE 发出之前 |\n| `c-prepare-sent:<txn>` | PREPARE 全部发出之后 |\n| `c-vote-recv:<txn>` | 协调者每收到一票之后 |\n| `c-votes-complete:<txn>` | 收齐 3 票之后、**决定记录 fsync 之前** |\n| `c-decision-wal:<txn>` | COMMIT/ABORT 决定 **fsync 之后**、决策广播之前 |\n| `c-ack-recv:<txn>` / `c-all-acked:<txn>` | 收到 ACK 之后 / 收齐全部 ACK 时 |\n| `p-prepare-recv:<txn>` | 参与者收到 PREPARE、`prepared` fsync 之前 |\n| `p-prepared-wal:<txn>` | `prepared` fsync 之后、YES 投票发出之前 |\n| `p-vote-sent:<txn>` | YES 投票发出之后 |\n| `p-commit-recv:<txn>` | 收到 COMMIT、commit 记录 fsync 之前 |\n| `p-commit-wal:<txn>` | commit fsync 之后、应用并 ACK 之前 |\n| `p-abort-wal:<txn>` | abort fsync 之后、ACK 之前 |\n\n崩溃通过\"钩子 + sentinel 展开当前处理函数\"实现：钩子点之前已 fsync 的写留在磁盘上，\n钩子点之后的发送/写绝不会执行——因此崩溃窗口是精确的，而不是近似的。\n\n## 4. 协议实现要点\n\n- **WAL 先写原则（write-ahead）**\n  - 参与者：先 fsync `prepared`，再发 YES；先 fsync `commit`/`abort`，再改易失 KV、再 ACK。\n  - 协调者：先 fsync `begin`（含参与者名单和写集），再发 PREPARE；先 fsync 全局决定，再广播 COMMIT/ABORT。\n  - `internal/wal` 每条记录 `Flush + fsync`；重启时**只**靠重放日志重建状态，内存全部清零。\n- **幂等与重传**：PREPARE、COMMIT、ABORT、VOTE、ACK 均按 txn 去重，重复投递无害；\n  协调者对未决票/未 ACK 的决策周期性重传，因此 30% 丢包 + 25% 重复下事务仍能完成。\n- **参与者准备后绝不单方面中止**：prepared 后只做两件事——等决策、周期性向协调者发 QUERY。\n  代码中**没有任何\"prepared 超时回滚\"定时器**（见 `internal/twopc/participant.go` 的\n  `startQueryLoop` 注释）。这是避免部分提交的安全红线。\n- **协调者恢复（presumed-abort）**：重启重放 WAL——\n  - 日志里已有 `commit`/`abort`：决定不可更改，按记录重新广播并持续重传直到 ACK 齐；\n  - 日志里只有 `begin`（未决）：安全地补一条 ABORT。之所以安全，是因为\"决定 fsync 早于决定发出\"，\n    日志中未决意味着任何决策消息都从未发出，不可能有参与者已经提交。\n- **判定口径**：`internal/harness` 在运行结束后**直接读磁盘上的 WAL 文件**判定每节点状态，\n  不信任内存。同一事务出现\"某节点持久 commit + 另一节点持久 abort\"才记为 `partial-commit!`\n  并写入 `invariantErrors`；\"部分已提交、其余仍 prepared\"是合法的**阻塞**（全局决定是 COMMIT，\n  只是未能送达），明确区分为 `blocked`。\n\n## 5. 验收：在每个协议阶段崩溃重启 —— 无部分提交\n\n下表为实际运行结果（seed=42，每处崩溃后 downTicks=40 重启，horizon=600）。\n复现命令与自动化测试 `TestCrashAtEveryProtocolStage` 一致。\n\n| 崩溃里程碑 | 重启后最终结果 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| coord `c-begin-wal` | **aborted** | 重启发现未决事务，presumed-abort |\n| coord `c-prepare-sent` | **aborted** | 已 prepared 的参与者收到恢复后的 ABORT |\n| coord `c-vote-recv` | **aborted** | 同上，决定从未落盘，安全中止 |\n| coord `c-votes-complete` | **aborted** | 决定 fsync 前崩溃，恢复中止 |\n| coord `c-decision-wal` | **committed** | COMMIT 已落盘，重启重放并重广播，3 方提交 |\n| coord `c-ack-recv` | **committed** | 决定不可改，重传 COMMIT 补齐 ACK |\n| coord `c-all-acked` | **committed** | 无影响 |\n| p1 `p-prepare-recv` | **committed** | prepared 未落盘，协调者重传 PREPARE，重新准备 |\n| p1 `p-prepared-wal` | **committed** | 重启后仍 prepared，QUERY 得知 COMMIT 后提交，**未自行回滚** |\n| p1 `p-vote-sent` | **committed** | 票丢失则重传 PREPARE 后重投，决定后提交 |\n| p1 `p-commit-recv` | **committed** | commit fsync 前崩溃，COMMIT 重传后提交 |\n| p1 `p-commit-wal` | **committed** | commit 已落盘，重启即为已提交，重复 COMMIT 幂等 ACK |\n\n**所有 12 个崩溃点 `invariantErrors` 均为空**：无任何节点出现 commit/abort 决策冲突，\n无决策未落盘先发送。\n\n## 6. 阻塞证据（不伪装高可用）\n\n### 场景 08：协调者在 COMMIT 落盘后、广播前永久宕机\n\n`scenarios/08-blocking-coord-down.json`（`downTicks: 0`，协调者永不恢复）。真实输出摘要：\n\n```\ntxn T1   status=blocked   coordUp=false client=-\nBLOCKED txn T1 prepared=[p1 p2 p3] coordUp=false queries=108\n  reason: coordinator is DOWN; prepared participants cannot learn the decision and must not abort unilaterally\ninvariants: OK (no partial commit; decision durable before send)\n```\n\n完整轨迹见 `examples/output/08-blocking-coord-down.json`，其中关键时间线（虚拟 tick）：\n\n```\n10 durable coord record=begin  txn=T1\n11 durable p3 record=prepared  txn=T1\n12 durable p1 record=prepared  txn=T1\n12 durable p2 record=prepared  txn=T1\n14 durable coord record=commit txn=T1      <- 决定已持久化\n14 crash   coord downTicks=0               <- 随即永久崩溃，COMMIT 从未发出\n19 send p3 -> coord Query   ...            <- 参与者只能反复 QUERY\n20 drop p3 -> coord Query reason=node-down <- 协调者宕机，查询全部被丢弃\n...\nquery sends: 108（tick 19 一直持续到 tick 300）；node-down drops: 105\n```\n\n终态：3 个参与者全部停在 **PREPARED**，没有任何节点 commit 或 abort，KV 均未改动。\n参与者正确地选择**阻塞等待**而非超时回滚——因为协调者磁盘上其实已有 COMMIT，\n擅自回滚就会造成部分提交。这正面证明了 2PC 在协调者不可用时**可能阻塞**。\n\n### 场景 10：参与者投 YES 后永久宕机（终止阶段阻塞）\n\n```\nstatus=blocked  committedNodes=[p2 p3]  preparedNodes=[p1]  abortedNodes=[]\n11 durable p1 record=prepared; 11 crash p1 downTicks=0\n14 durable coord record=commit; 15 durable p2/p3 record=commit\ncommit retransmits to p1: 37 ; drops to p1 (node-down): 37\n```\n\n全局决定是 COMMIT 且不可更改，p2/p3 正常提交；p1 永远停在 PREPARED，协调者重传 37 次\nCOMMIT 全部因 p1 宕机被丢弃。**仍无任何 abort，无原子性破坏**——这是合法的终止阻塞。\n\n## 7. 场景清单（`scenarios/`，均可直接作为请求样例）\n\n| 文件 | 预期终态 | 覆盖点 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 01-happy-commit | committed | 正常全提交 |\n| 02-network-loss-dup-reorder | committed | 30% 丢包 + 20% 重复 + 抖动乱序，仅靠重传完成 |\n| 03-vote-no-global-abort | aborted | 一票 NO => 全局中止 |\n| 04-participant-crash-before-prepared | committed | prepared 前崩溃，无残留，重传后提交 |\n| 05-participant-crash-after-prepared | committed | prepared 后崩溃重启，QUERY 后提交，不自行回滚 |\n| 06-coord-crash-before-decision | aborted | 决定落盘前协调者崩溃，恢复 presumed-abort |\n| 07-coord-crash-after-decision | committed | 决定落盘后崩溃，重启重放并完成提交 |\n| 08-blocking-coord-down | **blocked** | 协调者永久宕机 => 全体 prepared 阻塞（证据） |\n| 09-participant-crash-after-commit | committed | commit 落盘后崩溃，重启已提交，幂等 ACK |\n| 10-blocking-participant-down | **blocked** | 参与者永久宕机 => 全局 COMMIT 下的终止阻塞（证据） |\n\n## 8. 自动化测试\n\n- `internal/engine`：同种子轨迹逐事件一致；崩溃期间消息被丢弃、崩溃前定时器失效；重启后恢复投递；崩溃 sentinel 精确中止处理函数。\n- `internal/wal`：append/fsync/重放、缺失日志为空、重启后以追加方式打开（不截断）。\n- `internal/harness`：10 个场景的端到端断言；**12 个协议里程碑逐个崩溃**的参数化测试；\n  确定性（同种子两次运行 JSON 轨迹完全一致；8 个不同种子下不变量恒成立）；\n  两个阻塞场景断言\"确实阻塞且有 QUERY/重传证据，但绝无不变量破坏\"。\n\n### 如实运行记录\n\n以下均为本机实际执行的原始输出（Go 1.22.2，linux/amd64）：\n\n```\n$ go test ./... -count=1\n?       twopc-sim       [no test files]\nok      twopc-sim/internal/engine    0.003s\n?       twopc-sim/internal/twopc     [no test files]\nok      twopc-sim/internal/harness   0.267s\nok      twopc-sim/internal/wal       0.012s\n\n$ go test -race ./...\nok      twopc-sim/internal/engine    1.017s\nok      twopc-sim/internal/harness   1.371s\nok      twopc-sim/internal/wal       1.023s\n```\n\n10 个场景 CLI 逐个运行，终态与第 7 节表格一一对应（committed/aborted/blocked），\n每个场景的摘要行都打印 `invariants: OK`；两个 blocked 场景给出了上文引用的查询/重传计数。\n\n**未通过项 / 已知限制（如实说明）：**\n\n1. 本项目没有，也按要求不做前端；交互方式只有 JSON 文件 CLI 与 Go 测试。\n2. 模拟器是单进程、单协程的确定性模型；它**不**测量真实性能、真实 fsync 耗时或真实 TCP 行为，\n   `fsync` 在此表达\"写已具备崩溃持久性\"这一语义，底层是普通本地文件。\n3. 阻塞是 2PC 的固有性质而非缺陷：场景 08/10 中只要故障节点不恢复，事务就会一直阻塞到\n   `horizon`。本项目不实现 3PC/Paxos 等非阻塞协议（那会改变题目指定的 2PC 语义）。\n4. 目前场景以单事务为主（足以精确刻画各崩溃窗口）；引擎与状态机本身支持多事务，\n   多事务压力场景未列入验收集。\n5. 未发现未通过的测试；如修改协议代码，`invariantErrors` 字段会在输出中如实暴露任何\n 两阶段提交（2PC）崩溃恢复 —— 确定性离散事件模拟器\n\n纯后端项目。在**单进程内**模拟 1 个协调者（coordinator）+ 3 个参与者（participant，p1/p2/p3），\n使用确定性离散事件仿真（virtual clock + 事件队列），网络可配置**丢包、重复、乱序**，\n支持在任意协议里程碑精确注入崩溃与重启。**不依赖任何真实集群、网络、goroutine 或系统时钟**；\n相同输入（含随机种子）必然产生逐字节一致的执行轨迹。\n\n本项目如实建模**阻塞式 2PC**：参与者一旦把 `prepared` 持久化，就**不允许自行超时回滚**；\n当协调者不可用时，相关事务会**阻塞**——这是 2PC 的本质属性，本项目用专门的场景和量化证据\n展示阻塞，而不是伪装成\"始终可用\"。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 目录结构\n\n```\n.\n├── go.mod\n├── main.go                     # CLI：读取 JSON 场景 -> 运行 -> 输出 JSON 结果 + 摘要\n├── internal/\n│   ├── engine/                 # 离散事件内核：虚拟时钟、事件堆、不可靠网络、崩溃/重启\n│   ├── wal/                    # 预写日志：每条记录 Append 后 fsync，崩溃后重放恢复\n│   ├── twopc/                  # 协调者 / 参与者状态机 + 协议消息\n│   └── harness/                # JSON 场景装配、崩溃注入、结果判定与安全不变量检查\n├── scenarios/                  # 10 个 JSON 请求样例（也是验收用例）\n└── examples/output/            # 部分场景的真实运行输出（完整事件轨迹证据）\n```\n\n## 2. 构建与运行\n\n要求 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo run . scenarios/01-happy-commit.json            # 完整 JSON 打到 stdout，摘要打到 stderr\ngo run . --quiet scenarios/08-blocking-coord-down.json   # 只看摘要\ngo run . --out result.json scenarios/07-coord-crash-after-decision.json\ngo test ./... -count=1\n```\n\n## 3. JSON 请求格式（场景文件）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"seed\": 1,\n  \"horizon\": 120,\n  \"network\": { \"baseDelay\": 1, \"jitter\": 1, \"loss\": 0.0, \"duplicate\": 0.0 },\n  \"dataDir\": \"\",\n  \"requests\": [\n    { \"txnId\": \"T1\", \"at\": 10, \"writes\": [ { \"key\": \"balance\", \"value\": \"100\" } ] }\n  ],\n  \"crashes\": [\n    { \"node\": \"coord\", \"milestone\": \"c-decision-wal:T1\", \"downTicks\": 40 }\n  ],\n  \"initialKv\": { \"p1\": { \"x\": \"1\" } }\n}\n```\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子，决定丢包/重复/延迟抖动；同种子结果确定 |\n| `horizon` | 虚拟时钟上界（ticks），事件队列排干或超过该值即停 |\n| `network.baseDelay` / `jitter` | 单向延迟 = baseDelay + uniform[0,jitter]，抖动天然造成**乱序** |\n| `network.loss` / `duplicate` | 每条消息独立的丢包 / 重复投递概率 |\n| `requests[].at` | 客户端 `BEGIN` 到达时刻；`writes` 为该事务的 KV 写集（发给全部 3 个参与者） |\n| `crashes[].node` | `coord` / `p1` / `p2` / `p3` |\n| `crashes[].milestone` | 在指定协议里程碑崩溃（见下表），崩溃点**精确到 fsync 边界** |\n| `crashes[].at` | 或按绝对 tick 崩溃（与 milestone 二选一） |\n| `crashes[].downTicks` | 崩溃多久后重启；**0 表示整个运行期间永不恢复**（用于阻塞演示） |\n| `dataDir` | WAL 落盘目录；留空则用临时目录，运行结束删除 |\n\n投票策略：写集里出现 value 为 `@@NO`（或 key 以 `!` 开头）的写时，参与者投 NO，用于强制全局中止路径。\n\n### 可注入崩溃的协议里程碑\n\n| 里程碑 | 语义（崩溃发生在……之后、……之前） |\n|---|---|\n| `c-begin-wal:<txn>` | 协调者 `begin` 记录 fsync 之后、PREPARE 发出之前 |\n| `c-prepare-sent:<txn>` | PREPARE 全部发出之后 |\n| `c-vote-recv:<txn>` | 协调者每收到一票之后 |\n| `c-votes-complete:<txn>` | 收齐 3 票之后、**决定记录 fsync 之前** |\n| `c-decision-wal:<txn>` | COMMIT/ABORT 决定 **fsync 之后**、决策广播之前 |\n| `c-ack-recv:<txn>` / `c-all-acked:<txn>` | 收到 ACK 之后 / 收齐全部 ACK 时 |\n| `p-prepare-recv:<txn>` | 参与者收到 PREPARE、`prepared` fsync 之前 |\n| `p-prepared-wal:<txn>` | `prepared` fsync 之后、YES 投票发出之前 |\n| `p-vote-sent:<txn>` | YES 投票发出之后 |\n| `p-commit-recv:<txn>` | 收到 COMMIT、commit 记录 fsync 之前 |\n| `p-commit-wal:<txn>` | commit fsync 之后、应用并 ACK 之前 |\n| `p-abort-wal:<txn>` | abort fsync 之后、ACK 之前 |\n\n崩溃通过\"钩子 + sentinel 展开当前处理函数\"实现：钩子点之前已 fsync 的写留在磁盘上，\n钩子点之后的发送/写绝不会执行——因此崩溃窗口是精确的，而不是近似的。\n\n## 4. 协议实现要点\n\n- **WAL 先写原则（write-ahead）**\n  - 参与者：先 fsync `prepared`，再发 YES；先 fsync `commit`/`abort`，再改易失 KV、再 ACK。\n  - 协调者：先 fsync `begin`（含参与者名单和写集），再发 PREPARE；先 fsync 全局决定，再广播 COMMIT/ABORT。\n  - `internal/wal` 每条记录 `Flush + fsync`；重启时**只**靠重放日志重建状态，内存全部清零。\n- **幂等与重传**：PREPARE、COMMIT、ABORT、VOTE、ACK 均按 txn 去重，重复投递无害；\n  协调者对未决票/未 ACK 的决策周期性重传，因此 30% 丢包 + 25% 重复下事务仍能完成。\n- **参与者准备后绝不单方面中止**：prepared 后只做两件事——等决策、周期性向协调者发 QUERY。\n  代码中**没有任何\"prepared 超时回滚\"定时器**（见 `internal/twopc/participant.go` 的\n  `startQueryLoop` 注释）。这是避免部分提交的安全红线。\n- **协调者恢复（presumed-abort）**：重启重放 WAL——\n  - 日志里已有 `commit`/`abort`：决定不可更改，按记录重新广播并持续重传直到 ACK 齐；\n  - 日志里只有 `begin`（未决）：安全地补一条 ABORT。之所以安全，是因为\"决定 fsync 早于决定发出\"，\n    日志中未决意味着任何决策消息都从未发出，不可能有参与者已经提交。\n- **判定口径**：`internal/harness` 在运行结束后**直接读磁盘上的 WAL 文件**判定每节点状态，\n  不信任内存。同一事务出现\"某节点持久 commit + 另一节点持久 abort\"才记为 `partial-commit!`\n  并写入 `invariantErrors`；\"部分已提交、其余仍 prepared\"是合法的**阻塞**（全局决定是 COMMIT，\n  只是未能送达），明确区分为 `blocked`。\n\n## 5. 验收：在每个协议阶段崩溃重启 —— 无部分提交\n\n下表为实际运行结果（seed=42，每处崩溃后 downTicks=40 重启，horizon=600）。\n复现命令与自动化测试 `TestCrashAtEveryProtocolStage` 一致。\n\n| 崩溃里程碑 | 重启后最终结果 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| coord `c-begin-wal` | **aborted** | 重启发现未决事务，presumed-abort |\n| coord `c-prepare-sent` | **aborted** | 已 prepared 的参与者收到恢复后的 ABORT |\n| coord `c-vote-recv` | **aborted** | 同上，决定从未落盘，安全中止 |\n| coord `c-votes-complete` | **aborted** | 决定 fsync 前崩溃，恢复中止 |\n| coord `c-decision-wal` | **committed** | COMMIT 已落盘，重启重放并重广播，3 方提交 |\n| coord `c-ack-recv` | **committed** | 决定不可改，重传 COMMIT 补齐 ACK |\n| coord `c-all-acked` | **committed** | 无影响 |\n| p1 `p-prepare-recv` | **committed** | prepared 未落盘，协调者重传 PREPARE，重新准备 |\n| p1 `p-prepared-wal` | **committed** | 重启后仍 prepared，QUERY 得知 COMMIT 后提交，**未自行回滚** |\n| p1 `p-vote-sent` | **committed** | 票丢失则重传 PREPARE 后重投，决定后提交 |\n| p1 `p-commit-recv` | **committed** | commit fsync 前崩溃，COMMIT 重传后提交 |\n| p1 `p-commit-wal` | **committed** | commit 已落盘，重启即为已提交，重复 COMMIT 幂等 ACK |\n\n**所有 12 个崩溃点 `invariantErrors` 均为空**：无任何节点出现 commit/abort 决策冲突，\n无决策未落盘先发送。\n\n## 6. 阻塞证据（不伪装高可用）\n\n### 场景 08：协调者在 COMMIT 落盘后、广播前永久宕机\n\n`scenarios/08-blocking-coord-down.json`（`downTicks: 0`，协调者永不恢复）。真实输出摘要：\n\n```\ntxn T1   status=blocked   coordUp=false client=-\nBLOCKED txn T1 prepared=[p1 p2 p3] coordUp=false queries=108\n  reason: coordinator is DOWN; prepared participants cannot learn the decision and must not abort unilaterally\ninvariants: OK (no partial commit; decision durable before send)\n```\n\n完整轨迹见 `examples/output/08-blocking-coord-down.json`，其中关键时间线（虚拟 tick）：\n\n```\n10 durable coord record=begin  txn=T1\n11 durable p3 record=prepared  txn=T1\n12 durable p1 record=prepared  txn=T1\n12 durable p2 record=prepared  txn=T1\n14 durable coord record=commit txn=T1      <- 决定已持久化\n14 crash   coord downTicks=0               <- 随即永久崩溃，COMMIT 从未发出\n19 send p3 -> coord Query   ...            <- 参与者只能反复 QUERY\n20 drop p3 -> coord Query reason=node-down <- 协调者宕机，查询全部被丢弃\n...\nquery sends: 108（tick 19 一直持续到 tick 300）；node-down drops: 105\n```\n\n终态：3 个参与者全部停在 **PREPARED**，没有任何节点 commit 或 abort，KV 均未改动。\n参与者正确地选择**阻塞等待**而非超时回滚——因为协调者磁盘上其实已有 COMMIT，\n擅自回滚就会造成部分提交。这正面证明了 2PC 在协调者不可用时**可能阻塞**。\n\n### 场景 10：参与者投 YES 后永久宕机（终止阶段阻塞）\n\n```\nstatus=blocked  committedNodes=[p2 p3]  preparedNodes=[p1]  abortedNodes=[]\n11 durable p1 record=prepared; 11 crash p1 downTicks=0\n14 durable coord record=commit; 15 durable p2/p3 record=commit\ncommit retransmits to p1: 37 ; drops to p1 (node-down): 37\n```\n\n全局决定是 COMMIT 且不可更改，p2/p3 正常提交；p1 永远停在 PREPARED，协调者重传 37 次\nCOMMIT 全部因 p1 宕机被丢弃。**仍无任何 abort，无原子性破坏**——这是合法的终止阻塞。\n\n## 7. 场景清单（`scenarios/`，均可直接作为请求样例）\n\n| 文件 | 预期终态 | 覆盖点 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 01-happy-commit | committed | 正常全提交 |\n| 02-network-loss-dup-reorder | committed | 30% 丢包 + 20% 重复 + 抖动乱序，仅靠重传完成 |\n| 03-vote-no-global-abort | aborted | 一票 NO => 全局中止 |\n| 04-participant-crash-before-prepared | committed | prepared 前崩溃，无残留，重传后提交 |\n| 05-participant-crash-after-prepared | committed | prepared 后崩溃重启，QUERY 后提交，不自行回滚 |\n| 06-coord-crash-before-decision | aborted | 决定落盘前协调者崩溃，恢复 presumed-abort |\n| 07-coord-crash-after-decision | committed | 决定落盘后崩溃，重启重放并完成提交 |\n| 08-blocking-coord-down | **blocked** | 协调者永久宕机 => 全体 prepared 阻塞（证据） |\n| 09-participant-crash-after-commit | committed | commit 落盘后崩溃，重启已提交，幂等 ACK |\n| 10-blocking-participant-down | **blocked** | 参与者永久宕机 => 全局 COMMIT 下的终止阻塞（证据） |\n\n## 8. 自动化测试\n\n- `internal/engine`：同种子轨迹逐事件一致；崩溃期间消息被丢弃、崩溃前定时器失效；重启后恢复投递；崩溃 sentinel 精确中止处理函数。\n- `internal/wal`：append/fsync/重放、缺失日志为空、重启后以追加方式打开（不截断）。\n- `internal/harness`：10 个场景的端到端断言；**12 个协议里程碑逐个崩溃**的参数化测试；\n  确定性（同种子两次运行 JSON 轨迹完全一致；8 个不同种子下不变量恒成立）；\n  两个阻塞场景断言\"确实阻塞且有 QUERY/重传证据，但绝无不变量破坏\"。\n\n### 如实运行记录\n\n以下均为本机实际执行的原始输出（Go 已知限制（如实说明）：**\n\n1. 本项目没有，也按要求不做前端；交互方式只有 JSON 文件 CLI 与 Go 测试。\n2. 模拟器是单进程、单协程的确定性模型；它**不**测量真实性能、真实 fsync 耗时或真实 TCP 行为，\n   `fsync` 在此表达\"写已具备崩溃持久性\"这一语义，底层是普通本地文件。\n3. 阻塞是 2PC 的固有性质而非缺陷：场景 08/10 中只要故障节点不恢复，事务就会一直阻塞到\n   `horizon`。本项目不实现 3PC/Paxos 等非阻塞协议（那会改变题目指定的 2PC 语义）。\n4. 目前场景以单事务为主（足以精确刻画各崩溃窗口）；引擎与状态机本身支持多事务，\n   多事务压力场景未列入验收集。\n5. 未发现未通过的测试；如修改协议代码，`invariantErrors` 字段会在输出中如实暴露任何\n
